findings.title: Ratio value-role validation has no conservative fallback, so a mismatched ratio now reaches the user with no finding, no gap notice and no repair
findings.evidence: `number = parallel_values.get(...) or _prose_number(value, remainder_start)`; if that is None the only retry is the finite ranking preface `\s*(?:创)?\d+(?:年|个?季|个?月)(?:新高|新低|高点|低点)[,，]\s*(?:实际|本期|比率)为`, and then `code = failure_code(...) if number else ""` produces NOTHING. Counterexample with products {'2026-06-30': {1.588}}: draft `2026中报含金量3年最高，为1.587。` -> _RATIO_NAME matches 含金量, remainder `3年最高，为1.587。`, _prose_number rejects '3' via _NON_RATIO_SUFFIX ('年'), the preface regex requires 新高|新低|高点|低点 so 最高 fails -> number None -> no DeliveryFinding at all. Delivered text keeps the WRONG 1.587, status is not downgraded to partial, no '部分逐期比率与本次计算产物不一致…' notice is appended and no same-turn repair note is emitted. Same path for `2026中报含金量3年新高，该值为1.587。` (connector 该值为 not in the preface alternation) and `2026中报含金量为2025中报的1.2倍。` (first token rejected by `_PERIOD.match`). At the reviewed baseline d38dab3f these inputs WERE caught: `re.match(rf"\s*(?:为|是|=|：|:)?\s*({_NUMBER})\s*(%|倍)?", remainder)` matched '3'/'2025', _display_matches failed and the whole clause was withheld, so the bad number never reached the user. So this commit fixes the literal ARL-0001 counterexample string ('3年新高，实际为') but converts one-character variants of the SAME class from fail-closed withholding into a silent pass. ARL-0001's recommendation to 'fall back to the previous conservative clause withholding when no plausible value token is located' was not implemented; docs/agent-product-door.md instead records the opposite decision ('不因定位不明删整句'), which discloses but does not remove the delivery risk. Introduced by this commit relative to the reviewed parent.
findings.recommendation: When a period + ratio label is present and a product exists for that period but no plausible value token can be located in the clause, do not return silently: either keep the parent's conservative clause withholding for that clause or emit `calculation_value_unverified` so the gap notice, partial status and same-turn repair still fire. Add regressions for `3年最高，为1.587`, `3年新高，该值为1.587`, `为2025中报的1.2倍` and a mutation entry that flips the fallback off.

findings.title: Only an explicit attribution phrase exempts a surviving absence statement, so an independently sourced absence fact plus its citation is still deleted
findings.evidence: In `_rejected_assertion_spans` a survivor is independent only if `_UNKNOWN`/`_HYPOTHESIS` matches, or it carries `[E\d+]` AND `_ATTRIBUTED` (`(?:官方公告|公告原文|公司原文)(?:称|明确说明|说明)`) in itself or in the immediately preceding surviving part. Counterexample with an l3_lookup trace: `收入可核[E1]，查询空白因此没有公告，交易所披露平台显示公司本期无新增公告[E2]。` -> part 3 matches `_ABSENCE` (无新增公告), has its own citation but no _ATTRIBUTED phrase -> rejected -> the sourced fact and [E2] are deleted. ARL-0001's recommendation exempted survivors that 'carry an independent evidence citation of their own'; this implementation is stricter. It is fail-closed (no false claim is published, notice + repair still fire) and docs/agent-product-door.md discloses '单独挂引用不代表前提独立', so it is a disclosed trade-off rather than a silent regression, but it is a real fact/citation retention miss in the class this repair targets.
findings.recommendation: Either widen the independence test (e.g. any citation bound to a fulfilled slot, or an explicit source/venue subject) or keep the current rule and state in the product door that absence restatements are always withheld even when separately sourced; cover the chosen behavior with a regression case.

findings.title: A dependent recommendation survives when an unrelated surviving part separates it from the rejected premise
findings.evidence: `dependent_run` is reset to False on every non-rejected part (`dependent_run = rejected[index]` in the else branch), so `_DEPENDENT` residues are only caught immediately after a rejected run. Counterexample: `收入可核[E1]，查询空白因此没有公告，利润可核[E2]，据此建议观望。` -> p1 rejected, p2 kept (resets dependent_run), p3 `据此建议观望` survives although its antecedent premise was deleted. Delivered: `收入可核[E1]，查询空白，利润可核[E2]，据此建议观望。`. No false factual claim is published and the coverage notice plus repair note are still emitted; the adjacent form (DISCLOSURE_CASES[3]) is correctly handled.
findings.recommendation: Track 'a premise was rejected earlier in this sentence' instead of only the immediately preceding part when evaluating `_DEPENDENT`, or add the surviving dependent clause to the repair note; add the intervening-part case as a regression.

findings.title: Separator widening is token-based, so residues outside the finite lexicon survive and mid-word 而/进而 splits can leave garbled fragments
findings.evidence: (a) Residue removal keys on `_ABSENCE`; an equivalent paraphrase outside that lexicon survives: `查询返回空白，因此可以认定没有公告，即本期为零披露。` -> '零披露' does not match `_ABSENCE` (only 零公告) and '即本期' does not match `_INFERENCE`, so the restated conclusion is delivered. (b) `_ASSERTION_SEPARATOR` contains a bare `而`, which splits inside words: `查询空白进而可以认定没有公告。` -> parts ('查询空白进', '可以认定没有公告。'); the final rejected run removes the preceding separator '而', delivering `查询空白进。`. (c) the whitespace joiner is `(?<=\])[ \t]+(?=(?:查询|检索|搜索|接口|窗口))`, so `收入可核[E1] 公告检索接口返回空白因此没有公告。` (leading 公告) is still one part and the sourced fact + [E1] are deleted whole. All three are cosmetic or fail-closed; docs disclose the non-general nature ('这不是通用自然句法解析').
findings.recommendation: Require a word boundary/context for the bare `而` separator (or drop it in favour of 然而|不过), consider widening the whitespace lookahead to any following clause, and keep the documented finiteness statement; add the garbled-fragment and 公告检索 whitespace cases as regressions so the behavior is at least pinned.

summary: The repair engages ARL-0001 rather than bypassing it. Detection context stays sentence-wide while removal is limited to rejected parts at raw offsets; _ABSENCE was broadened so the previously MISSED `因此可以认定没有新公告，即公司无新增公告` is now both detected and fully removed (the prior review's 'residue' was in fact a detection miss, as the producer states); separators now cover 、/—/——/--/而/然而/不过 and `[En]`+space+查询-class, so the sourced fact and its citation survive those joins; the Markdown span mapper no longer emits unbalanced markers; and the prose ratio path validates numeric role (rejecting period/count tokens), supports the finite '3年新高，实际为' preface and an explicit ordered '分别为' binding so period labels, neighbour values and citations are preserved. Independently executed probes pass: retention 6/6 with target_unchanged at this revision, the research-delivery mutation suite exit 0 with genuine red/green pairs for the new ratio mutations and restored-full exit 0 (305 executed), combined artifact tests exit 0 (282 passed). diff --check is exit 2 solely on the preserved raw archive bytes; fresh paths and archive README/manifest are separately clean, and the 225-file manifest verifies bytewise. Falsification nevertheless found a narrowing regression of the very class ARL-0001 flagged: because role rejection has no conservative fallback, `2026中报含金量3年最高，为1.587。` (and `3年新高，该值为1.587`, `为2025中报的1.2倍`) now produces NO finding, so the mismatched 1.587 is delivered with no 待核对, no gap notice, no partial status and no same-turn repair — the reviewed parent withheld that clause. The fix is keyed to the literal counterexample phrasing rather than the class. Lower-severity residues remain: a separately sourced absence fact without an 官方公告称-style attribution is still deleted with its citation; a dependent 据此 clause separated by a surviving part escapes; absence paraphrases outside the finite lexicon survive; a bare 而 separator can garble 进而. These are ordinary defects with targeted fixes, not an architecture conflict, so CHANGES_REQUIRED rather than BLOCKED. All judge=llm coverage here is a deterministic success stub; no model-backed finance conversation exists in these receipts, and nothing here authorizes merge, cutover or T3 natural-quality acceptance.
